expectations.text: All """ docstrings with descriptive first lines ending in a period
expectations.evidence: 'Acquires ``n`` tokens, blocking...', 'Attempts to acquire...', all with periods.

expectations.text: Docstrings describe semantics without repeating annotated types
expectations.evidence: Semantics-focused descriptions; no bare type restatement. Note: heavy Sphinx/RST markup (``x``, :meth:, ::) rather than plain Google-style prose, and a nonstandard 'Thread safety:' section name.

expectations.text: try_acquire Returns explains True/False; acquire documents blocking behavior
expectations.evidence: Both documented, including 'no tokens are consumed on failure'.

expectations.text: Inline comments follow spacing rules and explain intent
expectations.evidence: Block comments explain condition-variable rationale; no code-restating comments.
Class docstring has a 'Thread safety:' section (nonstandard section name, but the information is present).
